Admin routes of the notifications module. Every route needs a staff session and the permission named on it; send `X-Resolve-Locale: false` to receive every locale of a translatable field for editing.

## GET /v1/admin/notifications

List notifications for the current admin user

Parameters:

- `isRead` in query (boolean, optional).
- `page` in query (number, min 1, optional).
- `pageSize` in query (number, min 1, max 100, optional).

Responses:

- `200`: no description.

## PATCH /v1/admin/notifications/{id}/read

Mark one notification as read

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: no description.

## GET /v1/admin/notifications/log

List notification send-log entries

Parameters:

- `channel` in query (`"email"`, `"sms"`, `"push"`, optional).
- `from` in query (string, optional).
- `page` in query (number, min 1, optional).
- `pageSize` in query (number, min 1, max 100, optional).
- `recipient` in query (string, optional).
- `status` in query (`"queued"`, `"sent"`, `"delivered"`, `"bounced"`, `"complained"`, `"failed"`, `"suppressed"`, `"skipped"`, `"enqueue-failed"`, optional).
- `templateCode` in query (string, optional).
- `to` in query (string, optional).

Responses:

- `200`: Log retrieved.

## POST /v1/admin/notifications/log/{id}/resend

Resend a notification log entry

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: Resend queued.
- `404`: Log entry not found.

## PATCH /v1/admin/notifications/read-all

Mark all notifications as read

Responses:

- `200`: no description.

## GET /v1/admin/notifications/templates

List notification templates

Parameters:

- `channel` in query (`"email"`, `"sms"`, `"push"`, optional).
- `event` in query (string, optional).
- `isEnabled` in query (boolean, optional).
- `page` in query (number, min 1, optional).
- `pageSize` in query (number, min 1, max 100, optional).

Responses:

- `200`: Templates retrieved.

## POST /v1/admin/notifications/templates

Create notification template

Request body: [CreateNotificationTemplateDto](#createnotificationtemplatedto).

Responses:

- `201`: Created.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `409`: Code already in use.

## DELETE /v1/admin/notifications/templates/{id}

Delete notification template

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `204`: Deleted.
- `404`: Template not found.

## GET /v1/admin/notifications/templates/{id}

Get template

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: Template retrieved.
- `404`: Template not found.

## PATCH /v1/admin/notifications/templates/{id}

Update notification template

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Request body: [UpdateNotificationTemplateDto](#updatenotificationtemplatedto).

Responses:

- `200`: Updated.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `404`: Template not found.

## POST /v1/admin/notifications/templates/{id}/preview

Render a draft template for every enabled locale (no send, no persist)

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Request body: [PreviewTemplateDto](#previewtemplatedto).

Responses:

- `200`: Rendered preview.
- `400`: Body references an undeclared variable.
- `404`: Template not found.

## POST /v1/admin/notifications/templates/{id}/send-test

Send a test of this template to your own inbox

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Request body: [SendTestTemplateDto](#sendtesttemplatedto).

Responses:

- `200`: Test enqueued (honest outcome).
- `400`: Non-email template or no recipient email.
- `404`: Template not found.

## GET /v1/admin/notifications/unread-count

Get unread notification count

Responses:

- `200`: no description.

## Schemas

### CreateNotificationTemplateDto

- `code` (string, pattern `/^[a-z][a-z0-9_.]*$/`, min length 2, max length 100, required).
- `subject` ([OptionalTranslatableBodyDto](#optionaltranslatablebodydto), optional).
- `body` ([TranslatableBodyDto](#translatablebodydto), required).
- `channel` (`"email"`, `"sms"`, `"push"`, required).
- `event` (string, pattern `/^[a-z][a-z0-9_.]*$/`, required).
- `variables` (array of string, optional).
- `isEnabled` (boolean, optional).
- `sendEnabled` (boolean, optional).
- `category` (`"TRANSACTIONAL"`, `"LIFECYCLE"`, `"MARKETING"`, optional).

### OptionalTranslatableBodyDto

- `fr` (string, optional).
- `en` (string, optional).
- `ar` (string, optional).
- `default` (string, optional).

### PreviewTemplateDto

- `subject` ([OptionalTranslatableBodyDto](#optionaltranslatablebodydto), optional).
- `body` ([OptionalTranslatableBodyDto](#optionaltranslatablebodydto), optional).
- `variables` (array of string, optional).
- `sampleVariables` (object, optional).

### SendTestTemplateDto

- `locale` (`"fr"`, `"en"`, `"ar"`, optional).
- `variables` (object, optional).

### TranslatableBodyDto

- `fr` (string, optional).
- `en` (string, optional).
- `ar` (string, optional).
- `default` (string, required).

### UpdateNotificationTemplateDto

- `subject` ([OptionalTranslatableBodyDto](#optionaltranslatablebodydto), optional).
- `body` ([OptionalTranslatableBodyDto](#optionaltranslatablebodydto), optional).
- `variables` (array of string, optional).
- `isEnabled` (boolean, optional).
- `sendEnabled` (boolean, optional).
- `category` (`"TRANSACTIONAL"`, `"LIFECYCLE"`, `"MARKETING"`, optional).
